items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions Basie in the context of general jazz history ('Basie used to play at first', 'Basie was around at that time', 'Basie with his big band, he used to work down there at the Famous Door') but does not describe a personal interaction, collaboration, or direct professional relatio

ctx.x: A bunch of us got together and made it up, you know. It was called head arrangements. That's what we called those that we made up. And, in fact, that's all Basie used to play at first. You know, he had arrangements. They didn't -- when he left Kansas City they didn't have hardly nothing written. They were doing head arrangements, but they were good because they set down and worked it out the way they were going to do it. They would have rehearsals and say let's do this here, that there. And different guys would…
so's solo we'll do this-- (End of Tape One)
